```yaml
name: Copilot Environment Setup

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: copilot-environment
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Copy activation job files to Copilot environment
        uses: githubnext/gh-aw/actions/setup@v0.36.0
        with:
          destination: /tmp/copilot
```
